title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2610.32813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. translated_title: HarnessMM：面向 Harness Token 效率的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.32813v1 公告类型：新 摘要：智能体 harness 在工具反馈之后会反复调用推理，即使先前的一次调用已经确定了下一步动作。我们提出 HarnessMM（Harness Minus Minus），一种通过受保护决策复用与递归自我改进（RSI）来提升 harness token 效率的方法。RSI 从训练反馈中迭代地优化伴随式 harness 配置，并通过验证集选出用于部署的配置。位于模型-工具边界处的控制器复用已解决的决策来替代后续的推理回调，同时保持 actor 权重固定不变。可执行决策图存储精确的动作、字面参数、因果依赖关系以及公共守卫条件。受保护决策复用从观察到的回执中激活这些持久化的决策；认证回调替换通过原生接口执行这些决策，并记录已注册的慢回调的移除。对于新的语义决策、缺乏证据支持的情况以及选择器弃权（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: HarnessMM 通过递归自我改进优化 harness 配置，并借助受保护决策复用让智能体在工具反馈后直接复用已确定的决策来替代重复推理，从而在 actor 权重固定不变的情况下提升 harness 的 token 效率。
en_tdlr: HarnessMM improves agent harness token efficiency through recursive self-improvement and guarded decision reuse, replacing redundant post-tool-feedback reasoning callbacks with persistently stored resolved decisions while keeping actor weights fixed.
